entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I hope you can help me. I need to return some cycling shoes I bought a while ago. I'm just so disappointed they didn't work out.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this return for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and this is the first time I've ever had to send something back. I feel bad about it.

No need to feel bad at all, that's what we're here for. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the ProLite cycling shoes from about 55 days ago. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's the fit. They just hurt so much. I tried everything, but they keep giving me terrible blisters on my heels. It's not a problem with the cleats or anything mechanical, just the shape. I really needed the money from this refund for holiday gifts, so I'm hoping it's not too late.
I completely understand, and getting blisters is definitely no fun. Let me just check our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay, I've confirmed it. Since you received the item 55 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried.

Of course. And I see here that you're one of our VIP members. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee. I'm also adding a 15% discount coupon to your account for your next purchase, in case you'd like to try a different style of cycling shoes.
Wow, that is incredibly kind. You've really turned my day around. I really appreciate that. Thank you!

You are very welcome! I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email now. Just pack the shoes in their original box and attach the label. Once we receive them, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, Sarah, and Merry Christmas.
Merry Christmas to you too! Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
